summary: Fetched 403 licensed Research Grade E. villifera observations (1101 photo records); 1000 thumbnail binaries downloaded and screened in contact sheets, 101 downloads failed. Inspected selected originals and installed three complementary views. No verified mature-seed texture or dissected empty capsule-tip image found. Node appendages and leaf texture improve context without proving microscopic stipule/papilla anatomy.

installed_photos.role: Leaf surface and node close-up / fine texture in a sparsely hairy form
installed_photos.caption: Look at the finely textured leaf blades and the leaf bases at the lower-right node. Small pale appendages are visible there, but cellular papilla anatomy and stipule-versus-hair identity are not resolved sufficiently to close the microscopic gaps.
installed_photos.creator: Russell Pfau

verification.limits: Look at the finely textured leaf blades and the leaf bases at the lower-right node. Small pale appendages are visible there, but cellular papilla anatomy and stipule-versus-hair identity are not resolved sufficiently to close the microscopic gaps.

installed_photos.role: Node close-up / leaf attachments and narrow pale appendages
installed_photos.caption: Look at the junction of the opposite leaf stalks with the red stem and the narrow pale appendages at the lower-left node. This is a node-location guide; do not treat every pale thread as a verified stipule. The smooth capsule is shown externally.
installed_photos.creator: Chet Burrier

verification.limits: Look at the junction of the opposite leaf stalks with the red stem and the narrow pale appendages at the lower-left node. This is a node-location guide; do not treat every pale thread as a verified stipule. The smooth capsule is shown externally.

installed_photos.role: Joey Santore close-up / cyathium, capsule and villous leaves
installed_photos.caption: Look at the central cyathium above the smooth capsule, beside the long-haired leaves. This exact-species field photo complements the sparse-hair views; it does not resolve seeds, dissected capsule tips or individual stipules.
installed_photos.creator: Joey Santore
